description: Sends a DNS query like the dig command, to Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 or a nameserver you name, and returns the full answer with flags and sections. Supports many record types, DNSSEC data and TCP.

dnssec.description: Ask for DNSSEC records (the DO flag).

family.description: IP family to use. Defaults to auto.

name.description: The name to look up, such as example.com, or an IP address for a PTR lookup.

norec.description: Turn recursion off (the +norec option), to ask an authoritative nameserver directly.

ns.description: Nameserver name or IP, only with server=custom.

server.description: Resolver to ask. Defaults to cloudflare. Use custom with ns for a specific nameserver.

name: dig
title: Dig (DNS query)
